outcomes_added.question_summary: Find the three-digit positive integer \(\underline{a}\,\underline{b}\,\underline{c}\) whose representation in base nine is \(\underline{b}\,\underline{c}\,\underline{a}_{\,\text{nine}}\)
outcomes_added.observation: The model correctly translated the problem into an equation relating the decimal and base nine representations, then systematically tested possible digit values for \(a\) to find integer solutions for \(b\) and \(c\). It verified the solution by plugging values back into the equation and confirmed digit validity.
